Around [[3627 BBY]], [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Dol Narlock]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] '''team'''.<ref name="Narlock Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Navy dejarik team was mentioned in the Codex entry for Vice Admiral Narlock in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Narlock Codex" />
